provenance.attribution: NOAA National Geodetic Survey · CUSP shoreline
limitations: Clipped to county display extent from published z12 CUSP vector tiles; display quantization approximately8m and original source accuracy preserved in HOR_ACC.
Provider returned403 for absent or inaccessible tile paths; absence is not proof of complete county coverage.
Historical mean-high-water and alongshore line features; not live shoreline, legal access, a nautical chart, a land polygon or seabed geometry.

derivedFrom.file: fish public/data/slo-shoreline.geojson (the extract the coast bridge serves as /coast-data/data/slo-shoreline.geojson)

display.method: Features grouped by attribute, source date, citation, data source, extraction method, horizontal accuracy and creator; tile-clipped fragments joined end to end; Douglas-Peucker simplification; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals.
display.note: Display geometry for the landing page outline only. Simplification is separate from source accuracy (HOR_ACC, metres); not a nautical chart, legal shoreline or navigation aid.
